source.title: List of Open Problems and Questions

trace.notes: Normalized the input as one zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 1959541. Resolver/search metadata identified the exact work as Zbl 1023.54002, DOI 10.1016/b978-044450980-2/50021-2, the chapter 'List of Open Problems and Questions' in Recent Progress in General Topology II, pages 577-597 (2002). Metadata was used only to identify the work and candidate full-text routes.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure modes: metadata_only, paywalled_or_restricted, and blocked_or_challenged. Attempted identifiers and candidate routes included the original zbMATH resolver, zbMATH REST endpoint pattern https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/1959541, DOI/Crossref metadata for 10.1016/b978-044450980-2/50021-2, ScienceDirect PII route B9780444509802500212, Elsevier shop/book page, Perlego book page, and Google Books preview. Rejected candidates because they exposed only resolver metadata, table of contents, purchase/subscription pages, snippets, or preview pages without the chapter body containing the problem statements; local ScienceDirect fetch returned a Cloudflare 403, and local zbMATH/Crossref API fetches failed DNS resolution. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered within the bounded pass.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/1959541.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
